description_en: Initiates a full-duplex Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service call with support for personalized configurations
description_zh: 发起全双工智能联络中心通话，支持个性化配置
name: LlmSmartCallFullDuplex

parameters.help_en:
CalledNumber  
The phone number that receives the intelligent outbound call
parameters.help_zh:
CalledNumber  
接收智能外呼的被叫号码
parameters.name: called_number

parameters.help_en:
StartWordParam  
The opening greeting variable. Format: JSON. Specify the variable name and parameter, for example, `{"custom":"XXX"}`
parameters.help_zh:
StartWordParam  
开场白变量,格式：json 格式，开场白变量名+参数`{"custom":"XXX"}`
parameters.name: start_word_param

parameters.help_en:
OutId  
The external ID. The value must be 1 to 15 bytes in length
parameters.help_zh:
OutId  
外部ID,长度为 1~15 个字节
parameters.name: out_id

parameters.help_en:
SessionTimeout  
The maximum call duration. The call is automatically ended when the specified duration is exceeded. Unit: seconds. Maximum value: 3600
parameters.help_zh:
SessionTimeout  
最大通话时长，超时后自动挂断。单位：秒。通话时长最长 3600 秒
parameters.name: session_timeout

parameters.help_en: The voice code from the personalized voice interface. If this parameter is not specified, the value configured in the application is used
parameters.help_zh: 个性化音色界面的音色code不传使用应用上配置的参数
parameters.name: tts_voice_code

parameters.help_en: The voice speed. Valid values: 0 to 100. If this parameter is not specified, the value configured in the application is used
parameters.help_zh: 音色速度取值0~100，不传使用应用上配置的参数
parameters.name: tts_speed

parameters.help_en: The volume. Valid values: -200 to 200. If this parameter is not specified, the value configured in the application is used
parameters.help_zh: 音量取值范围：-200~200，不传使用应用上配置的参数
parameters.name: tts_volume

CallId.description_en:
The call record ID that identifies a call record.

When you call the LlmSmartCall operation to initiate an LLM-based outbound call, this call record ID (CallId) is returned
CallId.description_zh:
呼叫记录ID，用于标识一条通话记录。

在调用大模型外呼接口LlmSmartCall是，会返回此呼叫记录ID，即CallId
